---
name: feedback-commit-style
description: Fictional feedback memory about commit message style, for testing only.
metadata:
  type: feedback
---
Keep commit subject lines short and put detail in the body.

**Why:** In this invented example project, the release-notes generator truncates subject
lines over 72 characters, so long subjects silently lose information.

**How to apply:** When drafting a commit for the fictional [[project-lantern]] repo,
wrap explanation in the commit body rather than the subject line.
